description: Backend + persistence: add Activo flag to Categoria across entity, EF config, migration, DTO, service and controller, mirroring the Productos pattern. GET api/categorias stays all-by-default via an OPTIONAL ?activo filter; a new PATCH api/categorias/{id}/estado toggles the flag. This feature leaves the backend fully compiling and is the dependency for the UI feature.
steps: Entity: in src/SistemaAlmacen.Data/Entities/Categoria.cs add '[Required] public bool Activo { get; set; } = true;' mirroring Producto.cs.

EF config: in src/SistemaAlmacen.Data/Configurations/CategoriaConfiguration.cs add 'builder.Property(c => c.Activo).IsRequired().HasDefaultValue(true);' (mirror ProductoConfiguration's Activo mapping; the HasDefaultValue makes the migration emit defaultValue: true).

Migration: from repo root run 'dotnet ef migrations add AddActivoToCategoria --project src/SistemaAlmacen.Data --startup-project src/SistemaAlmacen.Server'. Open the generated src/SistemaAlmacen.Data/Migrations/*_AddActivoToCategoria.cs and confirm Up adds the Activo bit column to Categorias with nullable:false, defaultValue: true (mirror 20260930161734_AddStockMinimoToProducto.cs). If the running dev server locks the Server project and blocks the command, the server must be stopped first (do not kill it without the user; if truly blocked, set this FEAT status to 'blocked' with retryable=true and detail explaining the server lock). If dotnet ef genuinely cannot run, STOP and report rather than hand-writing a migration.
Response DTO: in src/SistemaAlmacen.Shared/DTOs/Categorias/CategoriaDto.cs add 'public bool Activo { get; set; }'.

Service interface: in src/SistemaAlmacen.Business/Interfaces/ICategoriaService.cs change 'GetAllAsync()' to 'Task<List<CategoriaDto>> GetAllAsync(bool? activo = null)' and add 'Task<Result> SetActivoAsync(int id, bool activo)'.

Service impl: in src/SistemaAlmacen.Business/Services/CategoriaService.cs: (a) MapToDto set 'Activo = categoria.Activo'; (b) CreateAsync set 'Activo = true' on the new Categoria; (c) GetAllAsync(bool? activo) filter the result where activo==true -> only Activo, activo==false -> only !Activo, null -> all (keep OrderBy(c => c.Nombre)); (d) implement SetActivoAsync mirroring ProductoService.SetActivoAsync: fetch via _unitOfWork.Categorias.GetByIdAsync(id) (includes inactive), if null return Result.Failure("La categoria no fue encontrada.", "NO_ENCONTRADA"), if categoria.Activo == activo return Result.Success(), else set flag, Update, SaveChangesAsync, return Result.Success().

Controller: in src/SistemaAlmacen.Server/Controllers/CategoriasController.cs: (a) add '[FromQuery] bool? activo' to GetAll and pass to _categoriaService.GetAllAsync(activo); (b) add '[HttpPatch("{id:int}/estado")]' + '[Authorize(Policy = "RequireAdmin")]' method taking '[FromBody] SistemaAlmacen.Shared.DTOs.CambiarEstadoRequest request', call SetActivoAsync(id, request.Activo), return NotFound when result.ErrorCode == "NO_ENCONTRADA", BadRequest on other failure, else Ok(new { message = request.Activo ? "Categoria habilitada correctamente." : "Categoria inhabilitada correctamente." }). Mirror ProductosController.SetEstado.
acceptance_criteria: src/SistemaAlmacen.Data/Entities/Categoria.cs has a bool Activo property defaulting to true.

A migration file *_AddActivoToCategoria.cs exists under src/SistemaAlmacen.Data/Migrations with AddColumn Activo on Categorias, nullable:false, defaultValue: true, and ApplicationDbContextModelSnapshot.cs includes Activo for Categoria.
GET api/categorias with no query param still returns ALL categorias; ?activo=true returns only active; ?activo=false returns only inactive.
PATCH api/categorias/{id}/estado with body { "activo": false } flips the flag and returns 200; a non-existent id returns 404.
Building src/SistemaAlmacen.Data, src/SistemaAlmacen.Business and src/SistemaAlmacen.Server (compile) succeeds with 0 errors.
verification: dotnet build src/SistemaAlmacen.Server/SistemaAlmacen.Server.csproj -c Debug  (0 errors; if the running dev server locks the output, the compile stage still runs before the copy step - treat MSB3021/MSB3026/MSB3027 copy errors as the known server-lock, not a code failure, and note it in findings)
Confirm the migration file contains 'defaultValue: true' for the Activo column.
findings:
Backend complete and full solution builds clean (dotnet build SistemaAlmacen.slnx -c Debug -> 'Compilación correcta', 0 errors; the ~49 warnings are pre-existing NU1510/NU1902/NU1903 package advisories, unrelated). Details for the UI feature (FEAT-002):
- Endpoints: GET api/categorias (no param = ALL categorias, unchanged default), GET api/categorias?activo=true (only active), ?activo=false (only inactive). Toggle: PATCH api/categorias/{id}/estado with JSON body {"activo": true|false}, requires policy RequireAdmin. 404 when id not found (ErrorCode NO_ENCONTRADA), 200 on success.
- Success message strings returned by the PATCH: 'Categoría habilitada correctamente.' (activo=true) and 'Categoría inhabilitada correctamente.' (activo=false). Mirrors ProductosController.SetEstado exactly.
- Request DTO reused as-is: SistemaAlmacen.Shared.DTOs.CambiarEstadoRequest { bool Activo }.
- CategoriaDto now exposes bool Activo (new field) in addition to Id/Nombre/Descripcion/MargenGanancia/FechaCreacion.
- Service: ICategoriaService.GetAllAsync(bool? activo = null) + SetActivoAsync(int id, bool activo). CreateAsync sets Activo=true. GetByIdAsync includes inactive categorias so reactivation works.
- Migration 20261014144638_AddActivoToCategoria.cs adds Categorias.Activo bit NOT NULL defaultValue:true; ApplicationDbContextModelSnapshot updated with HasDefaultValue(true). Migrations apply automatically on app startup (DataSeeder -> MigrateAsync); no manual database update needed.
- UI should mirror Productos.razor: form-check form-switch bound to Activo with a _togglingId guard calling the PATCH, plus an estado <select> (activos|inactivos|todos) where 'activos' default sends ?activo=true, 'inactivos' sends ?activo=false, and 'todos' omits the param. The user wants the Categorías page to DEFAULT to showing active categorias, so the client should request ?activo=true on initial load (server default stays all-by-default per compatibility constraint; do NOT change the server default and do NOT modify Productos.razor / ProductoForm.razor).
- SERVER-LOCK CAVEAT: the SistemaAlmacen.Server dev process locks src/SistemaAlmacen.Server/bin DLLs while running, so any build/ef command outputting the Server project fails with MSB3021/MSB3026/MSB3027 copy errors (NOT compile errors). The migration was generated and the full-solution build was done after the user stopped the dev server; do not restart it on their behalf.
